SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-12-2016 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-20-2016 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT AFTER PARTICIPATING IN A MEDIATION SESSION CONDUCTED BY STUDENTS FROM HASTINGS SCHOOL OF LAW. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF KENNETH J. CISNE, JR. & DEFENDANT JOSE DE JESUS SAAVERDA. PARTIES SIGNED THE STIPULATION FOR PRO TEM JUDGE. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. THE COURT SHALL DISMISS THIS MATTER WITH PREJUDICE IF NEITHER PARTY APPEARS AT THE NEXT CALLING OF THE CASE ON 10/20/16. JUDGE: PRO TEM: JOANNE MADDEN. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. (D506).
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PER MINUTES STATED ON SEPT 12, 2016. NO APPEARANCES BY EITHER PARTIES. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED. AS STATED IN THE MINUTES ON SEPT. 12, 2016 (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)
